definitions.explanation: A vertical structural support in a building. In traditional Japanese architecture, wooden pillars are essential elements.
A person or thing that provides essential support.

notes:
{柱|はしら} refers to pillars and columns.

Types in traditional architecture:
- ⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧ (main pillar, also "mainstay")
- ⟦{床柱|とこばしら}→床柱：noentry⟧ (alcove pillar in tokonoma)
- ⟦{通|とお}し→通す：02300_toosu⟧{柱|はしら} (continuous pillar through floors)

Cultural significance:
- In traditional homes, ⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧ is central and sacred
- Children's height often marked on pillars as family memory
- Fine wood species used for visible pillars

Figurative expressions:
- ⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧ (main pillar/breadwinner of family)
- {柱|はしら}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a pillar/mainstay)
- ⟦{四本柱|しほんばしら}→四本柱：noentry⟧ (four pillars - sumo ring)

Counter for pillars: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00688_hon⟧
Counter for gods/spirits: {柱|はしら} (archaic/literary)
